title: Animals
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Environmental Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Environmental Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names food items from animals and matches each to the animal that gives it.

floor.prerequisite: Knows domestic animals used as food.
floor.question: Name an animal kept for meat.

steps: Match each food to its animal.
Find foods that come from more than one animal.
Sort foods: from animals or from plants.
contexts: a fish market at the lake

board.do: Draw a cow, a hen, a bee and a fish.

board.say: Which food does it give us?

board.do: Wait for the child to say honey.
Draw a line from each animal to its food.

misconceptions.ask: Which other animals give milk apart from cows?
misconceptions.repair: Show pictures of goat and camel milk in northern Kenya.
Show a beehive picture: bees make honey from flower nectar.

misconceptions.ask: Do ducks lay eggs that people eat?
misconceptions.repair: Show hen, duck and quail eggs. Many birds lay eggs.
Show how cream from milk is churned into butter and heated into ghee.

checks.question: Name a food from a goat.
